_comment: Official FIFA World Cup 2026 Round of 32 structure (48-team format). Entries are ordered in bracket depth-first sequence so the bracket renderer's pairwise merge (positions 2k, 2k+1 feed the next round) reconstructs the real tournament tree through to the final. 'matchNumber' is the official FIFA match number; 'home'/'away' are group-position references resolved to real teams once the draw is known. Source: en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2026_FIFA_World_Cup_knockout_stage
